name: Vinarosa Resort & Spa
positioning: Vineyard resort with a spa on 92 acres of vineyards in Santa Rosa, in central Sonoma County
best_for: Travelers who want a Sonoma County wine-country base among vineyards
Guests flying into Charles M. Schulz-Sonoma County Airport

facts.text: Some of the most renowned Pinot Noir and Chardonnay grapes are grown in the region.
The resort is 60 miles north of San Francisco.
The resort is a 10-minute drive from Charles M. Schulz-Sonoma County Airport (STS).
The resort offers a parking valet and access to luxury transportation services.
The resort takes spa reservations alongside restaurant reservations.
Dining options include John Ash and The Front Room.
The resort's address is 4350 Barnes Road, Santa Rosa, CA 95403.

highlights.text: The resort is set amid 92 acres of vineyards in Santa Rosa, California.
Guests can hike and bike amid the redwood forests of the Russian River Valley, picnic on the Sonoma Coast, or explore Sonoma County's wineries and culinary destinations.
Santa Rosa is considered the heart of Sonoma County due to its central location.

considerations.text: The resort is in Sonoma County wine country, 60 miles north of San Francisco, not in the city.
WhataHotel notes the secluded Wine Country location may require a car for nearby excursions.
WhataHotel notes premium resort pricing reflecting the upscale Sonoma County market.
